issue_context.title: 0.110.1 - av.container errors with Camera, Stream, FFMPEG components
issue_context.body:
<!-- READ THIS FIRST:
  - If you need additional help with this template, please refer to https://www.home-assistant.io/help/reporting_issues/
  - Make sure you are running the latest version of Home Assistant before reporting an issue: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/releases

  - Provide as many details as possible. Paste logs, configuration samples and code into the backticks.
  DO NOT DELETE ANY TEXT from this template! Otherwise, your issue may be closed without comment.
-->
## The problem
<!-- 
  Describe the issue you are experiencing here to communicate to the
  maintainers. Tell us what you were trying to do and what happened.
-->
After update to 0.110 i was experiencing crashing every 10-15 minutes after homeassistant core had started.  UI and Cameras working fine inside Home Assistant however i had to remove and re-add Homekit devices after update as the bridge was reporting version 0.109.5 (previous version).

I am using YiHome Cameras with RTSP feed from YiHack-V4 firmware.  Previous to 0.110 i had no problems.  If i remove the cameras from the configuration.yaml i do not get these errors or random restarts of Home Assistant.

I also tried to use a generic camera but same errors appeared however restarts do not happen (from what i can tell).

## Environment
<!--
  Provide details about the versions you are using, which helps us to reproduce
  and find the issue quicker. Version information is found in the
  Home Assistant frontend: Developer tools -> Info.
-->

- Home Assistant Core release with the issue:   0.110/0.110.1
- Last working Home Assistant Core release (if known):  0.109.5
- Operating environment (Home Assistant/Supervised/Docker/venv):  Docker
- Integration causing this issue:  Camera/Stream/FFMPEG
- Link to integration documentation on our website: 

## Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml`
<!--
  An example configuration that caused the problem for you. Fill this out even
  if it seems unimportant to you. Please be sure to remove personal information
  like passwords, private URLs and other credentials.
-->

```yaml
stream:
ffmpeg:
camera:
  - platform: ffmpeg
    name: Camera_Bedroom
    input: -rtsp_transport tcp -i rtsp://192.168.1.xxx/ch0_0.h264
  - platform: ffmpeg
    name: Camera_DiningRoom
    input: -rtsp_transport tcp -i rtsp://192.168.1.xxx/ch0_0.h264


```

## Traceback/Error logs
<!--
  If you come across any trace or error logs, please provide them.
-->

```txt
Logger: homeassistant.components.stream.worker
Source: components/stream/worker.py:82
Integration: Stream (documentation, issues)
First occurred: 1:44:04 PM (3 occurrences)
Last logged: 1:53:05 PM

Error demuxing stream: No dts in packet

Logger: root
Source: /usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/bootstrap.py:253
First occurred: 1:44:18 PM (3 occurrences)
Last logged: 2:01:05 PM

Uncaught exception
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "av/container/output.pyx", line 22, in av.container.output.close_output
  File "av/container/core.pyx", line 267, in av.container.core.Container.err_check
  File "av/error.pyx", line 328, in av.error.err_check
  File "av/container/pyio.pyx", line 39, in av.container.pyio.pyio_write_gil
TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not callable

```

## Additional information
comments:
Having same issue here. Also using ffmepg for my wyze cams. My system seems fully functional but I have gotten the error twice so far.

camera:

  - platform: ffmpeg
    name: AC Camera
    input: !secret cam_wyze1_stream

Hey there @hunterjm, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with a integration (`stream`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L386) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

Getting the same error, and tried to add some debug info.  I'm not seeing any issue with HA though.  No restarts like the OP.    Streaming is working fine.   Just this odd error that comes up on occasion.

Restarted HA with these debug statements, but other than saying "starting stream..."  there was no other useful detail logged.  
```
logs:
    libav.py: debug
    bootstrap.py: debug
    homeassistant.components.ffmpeg: debug
    homeassistant.components.stream: debug
    homeassistant.components.stream.worker: debug
```

Interestingly,  after the HA restart, there were no errors at all until about 45 minutes later, the stream.worker "error demuxing stream" occurred.   And not until 10 minutes after that, did the uncaught exception typerror in av.container.pyio,pyio_write_gil occur.   There was no interaction with HA during this time.

I can cause the issue to occur simply by opening my camera page in lovelace. As @GaryOkie mentioned, the error does not popup in my logs until about 10 minutes later. I can reproduce this consistently...just have the wait the 10 minutes for the error each time.
Update from me, i have disabled the Stream component and i dont appear to have crashes anymore but obviously my cameras are no longer giving a feed.

I'm taking a look at this. Appears to be an issue upstream. Trying to reproduce and see if bumping to 8.0.1 will fix.

Does this actually crash your HA instance, or just throw the exception and continue on?

> Does this actually crash your HA instance, or just throw the exception and continue on?

I have an automation that sends me a notification on HA start and HomeKit service start and when this is active i am receiving those notifications without manually restarting so i guess that shows its crashing HA.  My docker container doesnt restart, only HA.

I managed to crash it earlier by sending a camera.record service call from the front end.

I dont know how to get more logging on, i have critical setup in my configuration.yaml
